name: TBLauncher
tagline: A fast, search-first home screen launcher
description:
TBLauncher replaces your phone's home screen with a fast, search-driven launcher. Instead of hunting through app drawers and folders, you just start typing and it finds the app, contact, or setting you're looking for.

It's based on the well-known KISS launcher and keeps the same simple, no-frills philosophy: a clean home screen that gets out of your way.
